text:
```yaml
name: Check links

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.md'
      - '**.html'
      - '**.rst'
      - '**.txt'

jobs:
  lychee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Run lychee
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v1
        with:
          fail: true
          args: '--verbose --no-progress --max-concurrency 10'
```
